facts.fact: The ANPDP director complains of some public institutions' lack of proactivity in complying with the Personal Data Protection Law, which the agency polices.
facts.system: Lei de Proteção de Dados Pessoais

facts.fact: The ANPDP, installed about eight years ago, acts through prior control, with José Manuel Costa Alegre speaking as its director.
facts.system: Agência Nacional de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (ANPDP)

facts.fact: The ANPDP requires authorisation before personal data are processed, especially sensitive data, and announced it will publish a list of non-compliant entities and apply the law's fines; no sanction is named.
facts.system: Agência Nacional de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (ANPDP)
